messages:
maya: Poll closed — Topic B (Dedicated deployment stories + benchmarks) wins at 58% vs Topic A 42%. thoughts on framing?
raj: love B. suggest angle = customer ROI + live cost/latency demo. keep it under 30 mins.
claire: heads up — we have a performance customer (Acme Health) willing to speak but prefers Spanish intro. can do 2min pre-recorded spanish opening.
josh: scheduling note — speaker availability: demo lead (sam) only free 9:30-10:15 PT. can we shift rehearsal earlier?
zoe: ops checklist: pre-recorded clip must be uploaded to gdrive + encoded to mp4 h264 by EOD Wed. I can handle encoding.
maya: run-of-show draft: 1) 2m MC intro (pre-recorded bilingual), 2) 10m customer case, 3) 8m live demo (failover + routing), 4) 8m panel q&a + CTAs. sound tight?
raj: add 2m rapid-fire takeaways + 3m CTA (trial link + benchmark repo). Also add a slide with lead-routing rules so SDRs know tagging.
claire: speaker kit: include 3 bullets in Spanish and English, and 1 slide with 1-sentence ROI stat. I’ll draft.
josh: tech rehearsal plan: 30m dry run with share-screen rights, + 10m rehearse pre-record playback. need attendee link and streaming test.
zoe: lead routing — after webinar, all registrants -> HubSpot list "webinar_dedicated_2026"; hot leads (asked demo in Q&A or clicked trial) -> SDR queue tag "webinar-hot". ops-bot: automated note: create list and tag rule will run for 48h post event.
maya: fallback plan: if live demo fails, play pre-recorded full demo clip (5m) and pivot to panel discussion. everyone ok?
raj: ok. also keep lower-quality alternative models in demo pool to reduce failed runs under load (use 8-bit quantized variant).
claire: rehearsal scheduling — can we do two slots Thu 9am PT and Fri 4pm PT so timezone-friendly for EU speakers?
josh: confirmed — booked Thu 9am PT and Fri 4pm PT in calendar. invite includes dial-in, meet link, and a short checklist: mic, camera, local recording permissions.
zoe: post-webinar follow-up: 1) immediate email with recording + whitepaper, 2) 24h personalized note for hot leads, 3) add to nurture sequence for 6 weeks. I’ll draft templates.
maya: copy needs one short headline focused on "predictable inference economics" + subhead about "reducing per-token $ by X" — Raj can you give metric?
raj: give me 48h for a verified stat from infra bench. provisional: "up to 3x cost reduction via batching+kv cache" (mark provisional).
claire: speaker bios + headshots needed by Tue EOD. I’ll ping folks.
ops-bot: reminder set: upload demo recording by Wed 18:00 PT; rehearsal 1 Thu 9:00 PT; rehearsal 2 Fri 16:00 PT; webinar Mon 11:00 PT.
maya: perfect. small ask — can someone volunteer to run the live Q&A moderation? needs to triage top questions and flag product bugs.
josh: I can moderate. will prep triage doc with tags: sales, product-bug, feature-ask.
zoe: noted. I’ll wire the lead routing playbook to SDRs and attach it to the demo invite.
maya: awesome team. wil keep this thread for quick updates — add anything critical here. :thumbsup:
